name: Night Racer
author: Dandyhorse
description: Race three rivals through a neon city at night. Your pace is your throttle; tap Turbo and Oil on your phone to pass and to fend them off.

champion.name: Champion
champion.description: Led the standings at the end of a workout.

oil-slick.name: Slippery
oil-slick.description: Spun out two rivals in one race.

hat-trick.name: Hat trick
hat-trick.description: Won three races in a row.

full-workout.name: Full distance
full-workout.description: Raced to the end of the workout.

variants.name: Night Racer (Bike)
variants.description: Your power is the throttle; the trainer feels the hills.

variants.name: Night Racer (Treadmill)
variants.description: Your pace is the throttle; the game never touches the belt.

difficulty.label: Rivals
difficulty.description: How fast the other three drive, compared with your steady pace.

hills.label: Hills
hills.description: Whether the trainer follows the road's climbs (bike only).
